faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Get answers to common questions about our computer repair and maintenance services
faq.stillHaveText: Can't find what you're looking for? We're here to help!

items.question: How quickly can you fix my computer?
items.answer: Most repairs are completed within 24-48 hours. For simple issues like virus removal or software problems, we often provide same-day service. Complex hardware repairs may take 2-3 business days depending on parts availability. We always provide an estimated timeline upfront.

items.question: What areas do you service?
items.answer: We proudly serve the Greater Montreal area and surrounding regions including the North Shore, South Shore, and West Island. We offer same-day service for most locations within Montreal and nearby suburbs. For remote diagnostics and support, we can assist customers anywhere. Contact us to confirm service availability for your specific location.

items.question: Do you offer on-site service or do I need to bring my computer to you?
items.answer: We offer both on-site and remote support options for your convenience. On-site service is available for businesses and home users within our service area. For many software issues, we can provide remote assistance. Hardware repairs typically require bringing the device to our facility.

items.question: What types of computers and devices do you repair?
items.answer: We repair all major brands of desktop computers, laptops, and mobile devices including PCs, Macs, Chromebooks, smartphones, and tablets. Our technicians are experienced with Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android systems.

items.question: How much do your services cost?
items.answer: Our pricing varies depending on the type of service needed. We offer transparent, upfront pricing with no hidden fees. Basic diagnostics start at $50, and we provide a detailed quote before beginning any work. Our monthly maintenance plans start at $29/month for ongoing support.

items.question: Do you provide a warranty on your repairs?
items.answer: Yes! We stand behind our work with a 90-day warranty on all repairs. If the same issue occurs within 90 days, we'll fix it at no additional charge. We also offer a 100% satisfaction guarantee - if you're not happy with our service, we'll make it right.

items.question: Can you recover data from a crashed hard drive?
items.answer: We offer professional data recovery services for various scenarios including crashed hard drives, deleted files, and corrupted storage devices. Success rates vary depending on the type and extent of damage. We provide a free evaluation and quote before proceeding with recovery attempts.

items.question: What's included in your monthly maintenance plans?
items.answer: Our maintenance plans include regular system optimization, security updates, virus scans, disk cleanup, software updates, and priority support. Basic Care includes monthly tune-ups and email support, while Advanced Care adds priority on-site service and extended coverage.

items.question: Do you work with businesses or just individual customers?
items.answer: We serve both individual customers and businesses of all sizes. We offer specialized business services including network setup, server maintenance, employee device management, and bulk repair services. Contact us to discuss custom business solutions.

items.question: How do I know if my computer needs professional repair?
items.answer: Common signs include slow performance, frequent crashes, unusual noises, overheating, blue screens, virus infections, or hardware malfunctions. If your computer is affecting your productivity or you're concerned about data loss, it's best to have it professionally diagnosed.

items.question: What should I do to prepare my computer for repair?
items.answer: Back up important data if possible, remove any personal items, and make note of passwords you might need. Write down specific error messages or symptoms you've experienced. We handle all data with strict confidentiality, but backing up provides extra peace of mind.
